questions.question: Which relation code does the pattern for "Tim Cook became CEO of Apple" emit?
questions.explanation: The became/is/was CEO of pattern is mapped to P169, labeled CEO of.

questions.question: What provenance does extract attach to a matched relation?
options: Only the subject string, with no source location
A model probability and a token embedding
The document title but not the matched sentence
The character span and the exact evidence text matched by the regex
questions.explanation: Each triple stores span=(m.start(), m.end()) and evidence=m.group(0).

questions.question: What does verify reject when checking an extracted triple?
options: A triple whose stored span no longer matches its evidence text
Every triple containing a two-word subject
Triples using relation code P169
Any object that appears in the source text
questions.explanation: verify compares text[s:e] with t["evidence"] before retaining the triple.

questions.question: How does build_graph represent a subject with two extracted relations?
options: It keeps only the last object for each subject
It maps the subject to a list of (relation, object, evidence) tuples
It creates one node per character in the subject
It stores relations without their source evidence
questions.explanation: The defaultdict(list) appends the relation code, object, and evidence for every triple.

questions.question: Which additional relation is not represented when the text says "Larry Page founded Google with Sergey Brin"?
options: The subject contains an uppercase first name
Google is not a possible object in the pattern
The co-founder relation between Larry Page and Sergey Brin
verify always rejects sentences with the word with
questions.explanation: The founded pattern can match the main Larry Page–Google triple, but no pattern captures the additional co-founder relation with Sergey Brin.

questions.question: What does the demo query for Tim Cook retrieve from the graph?
options: Every object connected to Apple under any relation
The first person alphabetically in the graph
Only a boolean indicating whether Tim Cook appears
The P169 object Apple, along with evidence that Tim Cook became CEO of Apple
questions.explanation: The query filters graph["Tim Cook"] for rel == "P169" and prints its object and evidence.
